quest.title: Sky-Gazers, Land-Walkers
quest.description: At Keqing's request, you accompany her to look into the matter of festive gift-giving...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.num: Fleeting Colors in Flight: Part II
chapter.title: Sky-Gazers, Land-Walkers

talks.objective: Wait until the appointed time (08:00 – 12:00 the next day)

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: I know that you must be busy, but please take care of yourself. Sacrificing your health is never wise.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to look for Keqing

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ah, you've arrived. I've made all the necessary preparations and even packed some handmade snacks.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh, that reminds me, I've also prepared some launch tubes made by Pengyi. I hope the adepti will like them. Is there anything else I should bring?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think that should be everything.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Good. In that case, let's first pay Madame Ping a visit in the city before heading out to Jueyun Karst.

talks.objective: Go to Yujing Terrace to pay Madame Ping a visit

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The festive season is upon us. This is no time to be running hither and thither. You should relax and enjoy the season.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I get it Granny, but you know, having lots of clients is a good thing!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm sure it is... But really, child, who could be seeking your help during the Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You'd be surprised...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Madame Ping! Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It's a pleasure to see you again, Madame Ping. How are you?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh dear, well look who's here. I am so glad to see you all in time for the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler, long time no see.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, and Lady Keqing is here, too.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The Qixing have prepared some small gifts for you to celebrate this festive occasion. There are some seasonal goods, two bolts of fine silk, and some exotic flower seeds which I picked specifically for you, Madame Ping.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I've brought all the lighter gifts with me, but the silks are still on the way. I just submitted them for delivery, so I'm sure they'll arrive in good time.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Please accept our humble gifts, I hope you'll find them to your liking.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Wow, those gifts sound marvelous! Please be sure to thank the Qixing on our behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Yes, how very nice of you. I'm sure the flowers will be most beautiful if you personally selected the seeds. Thank you very much, Keqing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Please enjoy them. We intend to visit the other adepti as well, so I'm afraid we must be going now.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: I presume you mean Cloud Retainer and the others? Yes, they should be over in Jueyun Karst.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: By the way, I've heard that you designed all the street decorations yourself, Keqing. You decorated the city so beautifully, yet you don't even have the time to go and see it for yourself. What a pity...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Yanfei really enjoys spending time at the festival, you'll find her wandering around there whenever she can spare a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: C'mon, Granny, I wasn't wandering around. I was providing essential consultation to my clients.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, is that so? Were you also holding consultations with clients while you stood in front of the Grilled Tiger Fish stand for all that time?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact, I was helping them calculate the prices. It's not easy, you know. I had to check a lot of different items.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you're working during Lantern Rite, too?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: That's right. There are no holidays in my line of work. I have to be ready whenever my clients need me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds exhausting! Paimon can't imagine a life without holidays!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well, though there are no set holidays, I do get to decide on my own schedule. I can always budget some time to relax.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Otherwise, I would always look exhausted in front of potential clients. It'd be hard to land new cases after leaving a terrible first impression.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Besides, what's the saying... Ah yes, "A rested worker is an efficient worker!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been to the festival yet, Keqing?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I was there many times when I was supervising the festival construction, but I haven't been there since.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I was planning to go after I finish my work, but the work keeps piling up... I ended up completely forgetting about it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go together once you're finished with your work.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Yes, I should take the opportunity to show you around while you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: But first, we should head to Jueyun Karst. If you'll excuse us, Madame Ping, we'll be leaving now.

talks.objective: Go to Mt. Aocang to pay Cloud Retainer a visit

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The festive season is fast approaching. What brings you to one's abode? Has the Ministry of Civil Affairs simply run out of work for you to do?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Well, with Lantern Rite just around the corner, I decided it was a good time to take leave and pay you a visit.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: But, um... where are Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Them? Hmph! Don't even get one started...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Oh? Is that not the Traveler? And the Yuheng too. A rare visitor, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite, everybody!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Greetings, venerable adeptus. And greetings, Ganyu.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Huh, Lady Keqing? I didn't expect to see you here.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: (The Yuheng of the Qixing? Here? Most fascinating...)

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmm... Most courteous of you to travel hither and pay your respects. What is the purpose of your visit, if one may ask?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It's the festive season and on behalf of the Qixing, I'd like to give you our regards. Please accept our humble gifts.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: As the governing body of Liyue, the Qixing must be busy with a myriad of affairs. And yet, you still take the time to visit one in this mountain abode. Eminently considerate of you.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Oh? What an amusing cylindrical device. I wonder what that could be...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: This is a new type of firework which has been modified by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. I've heard that you are fond of gadgets, so I've brought one for your amusement.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (Cloud Retainer... although she is not outwardly opposed to us, she is still skeptical of Liyue being ruled by humans.)

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (Maybe she thinks humans are still too young to handle it. Hmm, no matter, with time, our strength will become apparent enough. Before then, we should try to give her a good impression.)

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (Hehe... Good thing I came prepared! Cloud Retainer has a great interest in gadgets, so she will certainly appreciate this gift.)

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (Ganyu has said that Cloud Retainer is very picky about food, so I made sure not to bring any snacks to avoid upsetting her. I've given everything thorough consideration, it should all go well.)

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: (Goodness me, whoever would have thought... Oh? My, how very interesting.)

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: It is intricate, with ingenious design... And is aesthetically agreeable...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: (Yes, judging from Cloud Retainer's expression, it seems this gift was a success.)

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Very good, one shall gladly accept this device.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One surmises from Ganyu's words that you also wish to see Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper. Pity, your timing is most unfortunate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Are they not home? We wanted to see them, too.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmph. Those two old fossils...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Moon Carver has been most anxious to see how Liyue Harbor fares. But the agreement was clear. Liyue is now in the hands of the Qixing, and he cannot simply roam into the city and begin supervising others' work as he pleases.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: So, one tried to persuade him otherwise, proposing that if he could not be placated, he could go to the city disguised as a human, and take a brief look around. Alas, he is too stubborn, too proud. He would have none of it.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Thereafter, he left, claiming to have gone traveling. He has not returned since.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Mountain Shaper, however, is more open-minded. But he said he wished to look for something new with which to defend the tranquility of his mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: He told one that he was leaving in search of treasures, and one has not heard from him since... Wait! Surely this is not a case of two old coots in cahoots, rusing to excuse themselves that they might venture behind one's back to scurry away and go traveling together!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Seems possible...)
Huh? What's everybody doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: This voice... Is it Shenhe?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? So Shenhe's here, too. Is she also here to visit Cloud Retainer?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Is she the one that you mentioned before?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Hello, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Shenhe, this is Ganyu. You have most likely heard of her.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Oh— Hello, I'm Ganyu. I work at Yujing Terrace. I've heard that you've returned to Liyue Harbor recently, so if you need anything, please feel free to come to me.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I will. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I brought some food from the city. I heard that during Lantern Rite, people in Liyue bring food to share with their friends, so here I am.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (Oh no! I intentionally refrained from bringing any snacks. Is... Is this going to be okay?)

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Oh? And you even brought food for those two old fossils?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: After barely a few days in the city, you have learned so much. Thank you for these delectable edibles, Shenhe.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Phew...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Everyone, you shall all be staying in Liyue Harbor in the future. One should like to think that you will all look out for each other. Is that understood?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Will do.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Yes, understood.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: This place is much livelier than I'd imagined...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like it's time we change the topic!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, have you seen Xiao?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The Conqueror of Demons? One has not seen him of late.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, then he's probably not in Jueyun Karst. Let's go look for him in his usual spot at Wangshu Inn.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: In short, one is the only adeptus who has elected to remain in Jueyun Karst for the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Had Ganyu not come to visit, one would likely have stayed firmly put in one's abode to resume research of gadgets and mechanics.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I didn't mean to interrupt you. Please accept my profuse apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Haha, why the sudden solemnity? It would certainly not be the first time one has been interrupted on your account.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: As a youngling, you did so love to scurry around the place whilst one's attention was monopolized by mechanisms... You were especially drawn to a certain implement one had made. Oh, what was it...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (Oh no, here she goes again! This could spell trouble for Ganyu.)

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Huh!? Oh—uh, I'm sorry, Cloud Retainer! I—I just remembered there's something I must attend to. I should be going!

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Oh? Why the sudden haste? With the Yuheng present, why not settle this matter here and now?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Uh, n—no, it's something very important. In fact, I—I must see Lady Ningguang about it immediately...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: A matter so pressing that you must find Ningguang in person?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ahem... Ah, yes, Ningguang and I have different scopes of work, you see, and Ganyu has to report to both of us respectively. It's indeed not easy for her.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: (Lady Keqing is trying to help me!)

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right! I'm very sorry, everyone. I will take my leave!

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Huh, gone already... That child... She has always been easily ruffled.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One can sympathize, however. It is no simple thing to be a secretary. Nearly every matter in Liyue Harbor, momentous or trivial, passes through Ganyu's diligent hands.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: But even as an adeptus, she must never neglect her own health, lest she fall prone to exhaustion.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Ganyu is an assiduous worker, apt to foregoing food and rest once she is busy. Please make sure she eats and sleeps properly whenever you see her.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I will, Ganyu has always been a great asset to us. Her health is a priority, so I will take good care of her.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The Yuheng, reliable as ever, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: It was indeed a wise decision to leave Liyue Harbor to you.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: We will certainly strive to live up to your expectations.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: As for these edibles... Hmm, they do look delectable indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: You may leave them here. Shenhe shall bring these into one's abode, and one shall pass them on to Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper once they have made their return.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: This firework has an intriguing design. One must conduct a thorough study of it. And one also wants to hear what Shenhe has learned in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Yes, I have many interesting stories to tell.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Let us chat whilst one scrutinizes this device.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll continue your research even during Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, don't you rest during the holidays? This is a festive season, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hah, one has long been living secluded in the mountains and no longer observes the holidays. Worry not, one shall take appropriate care of oneself.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Rest is crucial. If one is too devoted to one's research and falls ill, one shall be in no fit state to test the devices personally.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it really that important to test it yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Of course. As one sows, so do they reap, and the joy of reaping is what one yearns for.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: If one spends all that time working on a machine, yet forgets to test the outcome...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmph, that would be akin to a chef who never tries his own food, no?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: It is unwise to put the cart before the horse.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Enough idle chatter, everyone. One must go and continue one's research. Come, Shenhe, this way.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Cloud Retainer leaves with Shenhe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A chef who doesn't get to try their own food... Hmm, that would be kinda weird.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You sure caught on to that one quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cloud Retainer sure does know a lot about gadgets and cooking! Though she can be a bit strange sometimes... but then again, she is an adeptus!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: That's the wisdom of an adeptus. She takes good care of those around her. Though she lives in seclusion, she also manages to bring everyone together.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: A hermit who's more social than most living in society. Hmm, what an interesting character.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, let's head to Wangshu Inn. Perhaps we'll find the Conqueror of Demons there.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: If you're looking for Xiao, you can check the rooftop terrace upstairs.

talks.objective: Go to Wangshu Inn to pay Xiao a visit

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Dr. Baizhu, here are the herbs... I've picked lots of them.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Splendid. Let me pack up and then we can be on our way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey you guys! What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Dr. Baizhu wanted herbs. So, I came to collect herbs, lots of them. And... Dr. Baizhu came too.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon... Oh! And Lady Keqing! It's a pleasure to see you all. We're here stocking up more herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Bubu Pharmacy always runs out of digestive herbs during the festival seasons. With Lantern Rite just around the corner, I thought we should get prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: We came all this way to collect some herbs, and we've picked quite the assortment. We'll be on our way back to the pharmacy once the herbs are sorted.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: I certainly didn't expect to see the Yuheng all the way out here.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I have some business to attend to here.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Ah, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It's nearly time to celebrate Lantern Rite and you're still running errands... hardworking as always!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I appreciate the sentiment, Dr. Baizhu. I'm just doing my job.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Keqing and the Traveler are very busy... And we are busy too.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Everyone... keep it up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, keep it up, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Right, thank you, Qiqi.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: We shouldn't tarry here any longer. Take care, you two... Ahem! Three.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Traveler, let's go find Verr Goldet.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Ah, Lady Keqing, what a surprise! Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: No, thank you. I'm just wondering if you might know where the Conqueror of Demons is?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Oh, we never inquire about Xiao's whereabouts. But if he's here, he would be up on the rooftop terrace. Please feel free to go up and have a look.

talks.objective: Go to the roof to check

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hmm, he doesn't seem to be here. Perhaps we came at the wrong time?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe he's out battling somewhere again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's leave the gifts with the owner and ask her to...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: How can I help?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—Where did you come from? You scared Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Were you here the whole time, Xiao?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hello, I am Keqing, Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The Yuheng... Yes, I saw you when we battled Osial. You are fierce with your blade.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh anyway, we're here to give you some Lantern Rite presents! See, there's lots of tasty food!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Hmph, don't waste your delicacies on me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Qixing specifically prepared them for you.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Eradicating demons is my duty. You don't have to thank me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Karma is harmful to humans. Even though your constitution surpasses that of ordinary mortals... It would be best if you didn't approach me so casually.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, wait! Are you leaving?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, Lantern Rite is almost here! Don't you want to take a break?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't we go watch the fireworks in the city together?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Like I said before, I have no liking for crowds.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I must remain vigilant of evil attacks, especially during the holidays. I will continue my patrol as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You should also exercise caution. And if there's any danger...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, we know.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Good.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And he's gone...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Xiao hasn't changed a bit. Wonder if he'll come and watch the fireworks this year, though.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Alright, we've completed our visits with all the adepti. Let's take a break downstairs before we head back into the city.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After a short break, everyone gathers on the ground floor of the inn.

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: Oh no! What should we do!?

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: Huh? Oh, Lady Keqing, Lady Keqing! I'm so glad to see you here!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Pengyi? What's wrong? What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: Lady Keqing, let me explain...

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: I had rearranged the fireworks layout and expanded the range to Qingce Village, just like you requested.

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: My people finished setting up the fireworks and we left someone in charge to launch them for the show.

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: But... *sigh* the person we left in charge came back shortly after, and reported that all the fireworks in Qingce Village have been stolen!

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: I immediately reported the situation to the Millelith, and had another batch of fireworks made to be transported to Qingce Village under escort.

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: However, everyone's short-handed during Lantern Rite. The Millelith are already stretched thin and don't even have enough people to fill their regular patrols. They can't spare anyone to look after the fireworks for us.

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: We don't have many materials left, so if the second batch of fireworks gets stolen as well, we're done for... So, I was thinking to go to Qingce Village and have a look first.

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: Which is when I bumped into you. Lady Keqing, what should we do?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: According to the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the number of guards on patrol has to be doubled and rotated continuously during Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: They must perform these extra measures in addition to their standard daily affairs. The only manpower they can muster during the festival would be the emergency response units.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: But, those special units are intended only for backup. There are not many of them, and they cannot perform prolonged guard duty. If we wish to make use of them, we'll need to resolve the problem quickly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, maybe we could ask the adepti for help...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This would be a piece of cake for someone like Cloud Retainer or Xiao!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: *sigh* No, that would only make us look incompetent. I'll handle this, Pengyi.

choices.text: (We can't let Keqing do this all by herself.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We can help too, Keqing!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Thanks, you two. Actually, I have an idea. Let me make some arrangements.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Pengyi, go back to Liyue Harbor and get the fireworks ready, then meet me in Qingce Village.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Traveler, come with me. Let's ask around to see what happened.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right, we can take care of this together!

talks.objective: Go to Qingce Village and ask about the situation

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: *sigh* How could a whole batch of fireworks just vanish like that?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hello, Granny Ruoxin. We'd like to know more about the recent fireworks theft.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Ah, Lady Keqing! I can hardly believe you came personally to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It's no trouble at all. Please, tell us what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Well, when they brought the fireworks, the children in the village were very excited, they were all gathered around watching the area for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: The workers piled up the fireworks and said they would go confirm the locations to set them off. That's when they left the village.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Now let me remember... Ah yes, I recall that they left the fireworks in an open area, just next to a house down the old road.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: But, the very next day, all the fireworks were nowhere to be seen. The person in charge of the fireworks was so anxious that they went straight back to the city to find a solution.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: *sigh* The villagers here are worried too. The fireworks missing can only mean that there are thieves about. There are elderly and kids in the village, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Although the Millelith are stationed here, no one dares to go out anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I understand. Please help reassure the people in the village and tell them everything's going to be fine with the Millelith standing guard.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Traveler, let's go investigate the place where the fireworks were stolen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the place... The fireworks were stolen here.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The thieves must think there are mostly elderly and children living in Qingce Village, all too weak to defend themselves. Otherwise, they would never dare commit such a blatant crime.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: This is absolutely awful. We cannot let such a matter go unpunished.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Let's see if we can find any clues here before we plan our next step.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: *sigh* How could such a terrible thing happen during a festival?

talks.objective: Continue following the road to look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Lady Keqing is so hard-working. Maybe I should take a leaf out of her book...

talks.objective: Continue following the road to look for clues
Continue following the road to look for clues

dialogues.text: Sir! Please, this is all just a big misunderstanding!
A misunderstanding, you say? If so, then tell me, why are you hiding here?
Please, good sir! This really is just a misunderstanding! I would never dream of getting anywhere near the Feiyun Commerce Guild's shipment!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Something's happening over there. Let's go have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, the Feiyun Commerce Guild? It must be...

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Please, save your breath.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Restrain this fellow! Tightly now, we mustn't let him get away.

dialogues.speaker: Hongxing
dialogues.text: Yes, young master!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: I was sure it was an evil spirit... Turns out it's the Treasure Hoarders again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xingqiu and Chongyun! Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you guys doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Well, hello, dear Traveler! Our fates cross once again. What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Excuse me, please tell me what is happening here.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Ah yes, allow me to explain. It so happens that every year during the Lantern Rite, the Feiyun Commerce Guild transports supplies to various villages outside of Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Family rules stipulate that the supplies must be personally escorted by a family member. Because my older brother went last year, the duties have fallen to me this time around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so what's Chongyun doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Chongyun happened to be visiting, so I cordially invited him to join us for the journey.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, I see. But why did Chongyun say he thought there was an evil spirit?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I see that you are not familiar with the story of old. It is said that fireworks were once called firecrackers, and were used to ward off evil spirits and the like.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: In ancient times, Liyue was plagued by evil spirits. As people gathered together to celebrate the annual festival, the yang energy would intensify, and evil spirits were thus attracted to the fringes of the city by the strong scent.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor was under the gracious protection of Rex Lapis, so the spirits dared not enter the city. However, they still lingered near the city gates and pestered the passersby.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: In order to drive the spirits away, people made firecrackers and lit them near the city gates. The flashes of light and loud noise successfully drove the spirits whence they came.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: This festival is now known as the Lantern Rite. It was my intention to travel around to see if there are any malicious spirits lying in wait for passersby.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Since I happened to have a shipment of goods to deliver and our course was through the mountains, I naturally thought it best to have my thaumaturge friend traveling alongside me.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Xingqiu said he learned the story about evil spirits from an ancient text.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: The text vividly describes the appearance and even the whereabouts of the spirits.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Anyway, when we arrived at the area, Chongyun sensed an ambush about to take place.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Upon searching the area, we found a group of Treasure Hoarders. They tried to flee the moment we were upon them.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Fortunately, I was swift enough to catch one of them. Your timing couldn't have been more fortunate, we were just preparing to send them to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: He insists the matter is merely a misunderstanding. But things seem quite clear as I see it...

response.speaker: Kangsheng
response.text: Good sir, just hear me out! Everyone knows the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Had we known it was your merchant caravan, we never would have dared to attack!

response.speaker: Kangsheng
response.text: The master of the Feiyun Commerce Guild is famous for his generosity and noble deeds. A true hero of the people...

response.speaker: Kangsheng
response.text: So, you see, this is nothing but a big misunderstanding! W—We didn't want any trouble with the guild!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: What you mean to say is that you were targeting someone else, then. Well, who was it?

response.speaker: Kangsheng
response.text: I... uh, well... Just trust me, we were definitely not trying to steal your goods, please... please believe me!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Master Xingqiu, I would like to borrow a few of your staff to escort the thief to the Ministry of Civil Affairs. As for the bounty, we will pay you afterward.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: It is my humble duty to uphold justice. No remuneration shall be necessary.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Come then, see that this thief to taken to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

response.speaker: Hongxing
response.text: Yes, young master, leave it to us! You heard him, take this man over there and make sure he is secured. Tie each of his fingers separately if you have to, he's not gonna pull anything under our watch.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Wait a second.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Please also deliver this message to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It's very likely that this thief is related to the recent fireworks theft in Qingce Village. Make sure they have someone question him thoroughly.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Haha, so the plot thickens.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Is your task clear? We mustn't disappoint the Yuheng.

response.speaker: Hongxing
response.text: Yes, young master, I understand. We'll be on our way!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The guards take the Treasure Hoarder away...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I've heard many good things about you, Master Xingqiu. Thank you for your assistance.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I hardly lifted a finger. Think nothing of it.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Everyone, my intuition tells me that there could be more than one group of Treasure Hoarders in this area.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: More than one group?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Oh! You've got quite a keen eye, too, Chongyun!

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: During our search, I found scattered sets of footprints differing from those on the road. There may still be other Treasure Hoarders waiting to ambush passersby.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: When I was chasing the Treasure Hoarders earlier, I noticed that they were nearly unarmed and very few in numbers. If they truly intended to ambush the Feiyun Commerce Guild, they must've overestimated themselves.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If you ask me, they didn't seem to be staging an ambush, but rather, it appeared as if they were waiting for someone.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It appears they may be the thief's accomplices. They were probably hiding here to wait for the stolen goods.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: What exactly are the stolen goods, if I may ask?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Keqing tells them about the fireworks theft in Qingce Village...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Taking advantage of the elderly and children, what a loathsome group of criminals.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Lady Keqing, don't fret about manpower. Chongyun, let's go lend them a hand in Qingce Village, shall we?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Yeah, just leave it to us! We can handle a bunch of thieves.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Thank you, that will help alleviate the crisis in Qingce Village. Unfortunately, the footprints we were following end here. I don't know where we should go next.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It seems we were only a moment away from catching all the Treasure Hoarders...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Keqing...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Master Xingqiu, I'll leave Qingce Village under your watch.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Most assuredly, Lady Keqing.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Chongyun and Xingqiu leave for Qingce Village.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Phew, it's fortunate our paths crossed with those two.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's always good to have some help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's so cool to fight for justice!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The thieves who stole the fireworks haven't revealed themselves yet.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I'll go have a look around. Traveler, please go take a rest in Qingce Village.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I've troubled you enough already. I can handle the rest of this matter myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Keqing... Are you planning to look for clues all by yourself? Somehow, that doesn't sound like a very good idea.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, wait! You're in the Liyue Qixing! Why don't you ask some of your subordinates to help?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At least it'll be safer than investigating on your own.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon's right.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Yes, I agree, but we are short-handed at the moment. I can handle these trivial matters myself.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The fireworks that were transported to Qingce Village were quite bulky. They couldn't have gone far.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Way I see it, if they were clever enough, they would conceal the stolen goods somewhere and then come pick them up later.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: All I have to do is find out where they hid the fireworks, and then return to the location with reinforcements.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Don't worry, I am not reckless, and I won't carelessly alert the thieves. You can certainly trust me by now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, when you put it that way...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It's settled, then. Traveler and Paimon, please go get some rest. I'll go find you in Qingce Village when I'm done.

choices.text: We'll find a way to catch them.
(Chongyun never got to see the book, did he?)

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Dr. Baizhu, are we done yet?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Yes, almost. But don't rush me, just give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Let's see... which adeptus shall we visit first?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. Oh, why don't we visit Cloud Retainer at Mt. Aocang first?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She usually stays inside her abode, so she'll be super easy to find.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Alright, Cloud Retainer it is.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Let's ask Verr Goldet where the Conqueror of Demons may be.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Hold on, isn't that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qiqi! Oh, and the weird guy with the snake around his neck!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are these footprints?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Let's see where they lead.
